requirement_text: The MET shall be initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame.
requirement_text_raw: The MET shall (3.3.10.5) be initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the MET initialized to zero at the first 50 Hz frame, so that elapsed time starts from a known value.
technical_task: Set the MET to zero when the first 50 Hz frame starts.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system starts, when the first 50 Hz frame begins, then the MET is zero.
Given later 50 Hz frames, when they begin, then the MET is not reset to zero by this initialization.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The second criterion is an interpretation of "first".

requirement_text: Only managers are able to perform search queries for reservations by user. 100% of all search queries for reservations by user shall be from logons of only management logons.
requirement_text_raw: Only managers are able to perform search queries for reservations by user.  100\% of all search queries for reservations by user shall be from logons of only management logons.'
user_story: As a manager, I want only managers to search reservations by user, so that user reservation data stays restricted.
technical_task: Restrict search of reservations by user to management logons so that 100% of such searches come from management logons.
acceptance_criteria: Given a management logon, when it searches reservations by user, then the search is performed.
Given a logon that is not a management logon, when it tries to search reservations by user, then the search is refused.
rationale: Role stated: manager. The 100% figure is covered by the second criterion.

requirement_text: If a request is approved, the status will be marked as "Borrow" with an end date.
user_story: As a librarian, I want an approved request to be marked "Borrow" with an end date, so that I can see when the item is due back.
technical_task: When a request is approved, set its status to "Borrow" and store an end date.
acceptance_criteria: Given a request is approved, when the approval is saved, then its status is "Borrow".
Given a request is approved, when the approval is saved, then an end date is set on it.
rationale: Role assumed: librarian. How the end date is chosen is not stated.

requirement_text: Under all circumstances the sensor 's output pulses must be a true image of the moving target teeth, e.g. while change of rotational direction at any angle position, under vibration effects or at strong temperature change no "missing tooth" or additional pulse may occur, also after longer stop-periods and temperature changes (stop-start-mode of the engine).
user_story: As a sensor engineer, I want the sensor's output pulses to be a true image of the moving target teeth under all circumstances, so that no tooth is missed and no pulse is added.
technical_task: Verify that the output pulses stay a true image of the target teeth, with no "missing tooth" and no additional pulse, during direction changes at any angle position, vibration, strong temperature change and after longer stop periods.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change of rotational direction at any angle position, when the sensor outputs pulses, then no "missing tooth" or additional pulse occurs.
Given vibration or strong temperature change, when the sensor outputs pulses, then no "missing tooth" or additional pulse occurs.
Given longer stop periods and temperature changes in the stop-start-mode of the engine, when the sensor restarts, then no "missing tooth" or additional pulse occurs.
rationale: Role assumed: sensor engineer. "Strong" temperature change is not quantified.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to highlight text, add notes, and create bookmarks.
user_story: As a reader, I want to highlight text, add notes and create bookmarks, so that I can mark what matters.
technical_task: Add text highlighting, note taking and bookmark creation to the reading view.
acceptance_criteria: Given displayed text, when the user highlights a passage, then the highlight is saved.
Given displayed text, when the user adds a note or creates a bookmark, then the note or bookmark is saved.

requirement_text: The NE shall support at least two physical processors per FCR.
requirement_text_raw: The NE shall (3.2.3.2.2) support at least two physical processors per FCR.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want the NE to support at least two physical processors per FCR, so that redundancy is possible.
technical_task: Design the NE with room for at least two physical processors for each FCR.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCR, when the NE is configured, then at least two physical processors are supported.
Given an FCR with two physical processors, when the NE starts, then both are recognized.

requirement_text: A successful login brings you to the appointment calendar.
user_story: As a patient, I want a successful login to bring me to the appointment calendar, so that I can see my appointments first.
technical_task: Redirect the user to the appointment calendar after a successful login.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the user logs in successfully, then the appointment calendar is displayed.
Given invalid credentials, when the user tries to log in, then the appointment calendar is not displayed.

requirement_text: HCP must enter the MID of a patient and then enter or edit demographic information with the exception of the patient's security question or password according to data format 6.1.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to enter a patient's MID and then enter or edit demographic information, except the security question and password, so that demographics are kept up to date.
technical_task: Require the patient's MID first, then allow entry and editing of demographic information per data format 6.1, excluding the security question and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given the HCP enters a patient's MID, when the MID is accepted, then demographic information can be entered or edited.
Given the demographic form, when the HCP edits it, then the patient's security question and password cannot be changed.

requirement_text: The system shall allow authorized users to update the directory.
user_story: As an authorized user, I want to update the directory, so that its entries stay current.
technical_task: Allow authorized users to change directory entries.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user updates the directory, then the change is saved.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to update the directory, then the update is refused.

requirement_text: All FCP processing channels (up to 4) shall be incorporated into the FCP virtual group as they become available, provided that recovery and memory alignment is allowed by the application software.
requirement_text_raw: All FCP processing channels (up to 4) shall (3.1.23) be incorporated into the FCP virtual group as they become available, provided that recovery and memory alignment is allowed by the application software.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want all FCP processing channels (up to 4) to join the FCP virtual group as they become available, if the application software allows recovery and memory alignment, so that capacity is used.
technical_task: Incorporate each FCP processing channel (up to 4) into the FCP virtual group as soon as it becomes available, provided recovery and memory alignment are allowed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a channel becomes available and recovery and memory alignment are allowed, when it is detected, then it is incorporated into the FCP virtual group.
Given recovery or memory alignment is not allowed by the application software, when a channel becomes available, then it is not incorporated.

requirement_text: The system shall be compatible with various operating systems and file formats.
rationale: "Various operating systems and file formats" are not named.
clarification_questions: Which operating systems and file formats must be supported?

requirement_text: Communication services shall detect message passing between application tasks living on the same virtual group and bypass the usage of the network element.
requirement_text_raw: Communication services shall [SRS051] detect message passing between application tasks living on the same virtual group and bypass the usage of the network element.
user_story: As a software developer, I want communication services to detect message passing between tasks on the same virtual group and bypass the network element, so that local messages are quick.
technical_task: Detect messages between application tasks in the same virtual group and deliver them without using the network element.
acceptance_criteria: Given two application tasks on the same virtual group, when one sends a message to the other, then the message passing is detected.
Given such a message, when it is delivered, then the network element is not used.

requirement_text: All graphics will be in 16 bit colour.
user_story: As a user, I want all graphics in 16 bit colour, so that the display looks consistent.
technical_task: Render every graphic with 16 bit colour.
acceptance_criteria: Given any graphic in the application, when it is displayed, then it uses 16 bit colour.
Given the set of graphics, when they are reviewed, then none uses a different colour depth.

requirement_text: The contractor shall prepare the architecture to be able to introduce additional variants for certain countries, such as China.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the contractor to prepare the architecture for additional variants for certain countries, such as China, so that variants can be added later.
technical_task: Prepare the architecture so that additional country-specific variants, for example for China, can be introduced.
acceptance_criteria: Given the architecture, when a variant for a certain country is introduced, then it can be added without redesigning the architecture.
Given the architecture documentation, when it is reviewed, then it shows how additional country variants are introduced.
rationale: Role assumed: project manager. Which countries are covered beyond China is not stated.

requirement_text: The building, subsystems, and condition windows shall display the current time if the diagnostic tool is operating in real time.
user_story: As a technician, I want the building, subsystems and condition windows to show the current time while the diagnostic tool runs in real time, so that I can relate readings to time.
technical_task: Display the current time in the building, subsystems and condition windows when the diagnostic tool operates in real time.
acceptance_criteria: Given the diagnostic tool is operating in real time, when the building window is shown, then it displays the current time.
Given the diagnostic tool is operating in real time, when the subsystems and condition windows are shown, then they display the current time.

requirement_text: The system shall be user-friendly for various user roles (archivists, researchers, donors).
clarification_questions: What makes the system "user-friendly" for archivists, researchers and donors, measurably?
Do the three roles need different behaviour?

requirement_text: The system shall provide the ability for authorized administrators to assign restrictions or privileges to users or groups.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to assign restrictions or privileges to users or groups, so that access is controlled.
technical_task: Allow authorized administrators to assign restrictions and privileges to individual users and to groups.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized administrator, when the administrator assigns a privilege to a user, then the privilege applies to that user.
Given an authorized administrator, when the administrator assigns a restriction to a group, then it applies to the group's members.

requirement_text: The telemetry capability shall transfer the telemetry block from the FCP to the FCC-MPCC connected to the CTC.
requirement_text_raw: The telemetry capability shall [SRS149] transfer the telemetry block from the FCP to the FCC-MPCC connected to the CTC.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the telemetry capability to move the telemetry block from the FCP to the FCC-MPCC connected to the CTC, so that telemetry reaches the CTC.
technical_task: Transfer the telemetry block from the FCP to the FCC-MPCC that is connected to the CTC.
acceptance_criteria: Given a telemetry block on the FCP, when the telemetry capability runs, then the block is transferred to the FCC-MPCC.
Given the FCC-MPCC that is connected to the CTC, when the block arrives, then it is available for the CTC.

requirement_text: User shall experience continuous improvement in translation accuracy over time through machine learning algorithms analyzing user interactions and feedback.
rationale: "Continuous improvement" has no measurable target and the learning method is only loosely described.
clarification_questions: How is "continuous improvement" in translation accuracy measured?
Which accuracy metric and target should apply?

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to attribute record and display the identity of all users contributing to or finalizing a document or note including the date and time of entry (see appropriate criteria in IN.2.2 (Auditable Records)).
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide the ability to attribute record and display the identity of all users contributing to or finalizing a document or note  including the date and time of entry (see appropriate criteria in IN.2.2 (Auditable Records)).
user_story: As an auditor, I want the identity of every user contributing to or finalizing a document or note recorded and displayed with the date and time of entry, so that authorship is clear.
technical_task: Record and display the identity of all users who contribute to or finalize a document or note, along with the date and time of entry, following IN.2.2 (Auditable Records).
acceptance_criteria: Given a user contributes to a document or note, when the contribution is saved, then the user's identity and the date and time of entry are recorded.
Given a document or note, when it is displayed, then the identities of all contributors and of the user who finalized it are shown with the date and time of entry.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. The criteria in IN.2.2 are only referenced.

requirement_text: The timestamps shall be congruent across all members of the destination FCP.
requirement_text_raw: The timestamps shall (3.2.2.7.2) be congruent across all members of the destination FCP.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the timestamps to be congruent across all members of the destination FCP, so that they share the same time.
technical_task: Keep timestamps congruent on every member of the destination FCP.
acceptance_criteria: Given the members of the destination FCP, when their timestamps are compared, then they are congruent.
Given an operation that updates timestamps, when it completes, then all members of the destination FCP still have congruent timestamps.

requirement_text: Database will mark the account as inactive and user will not be able to log into the website.
requirement_text_raw: Database will mark the account as inactive  and user will not be able to log into the website.
user_story: As an administrator, I want an account marked inactive in the database to be unable to log in to the website, so that inactive users are locked out.
technical_task: Mark an account as inactive in the database and refuse website login for inactive accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account marked inactive, when the user tries to log in, then login is refused.
Given an account that is active, when the user tries to log in, then login is allowed.

requirement_text: If AC_InstantLineVoltage is smaller than 25 volts, the global variable shall be set to 0.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the global variable set to 0 when AC_InstantLineVoltage is smaller than 25 volts, so that low line voltage is flagged.
technical_task: Set the global variable to 0 whenever AC_InstantLineVoltage is below 25 volts.
acceptance_criteria: Given AC_InstantLineVoltage is smaller than 25 volts, when it is evaluated, then the global variable is set to 0.
Given AC_InstantLineVoltage is not smaller than 25 volts, when it is evaluated, then this rule does not set the variable to 0.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The name of the global variable is not given.

requirement_text: Each interrupt shall be preceded by the FCP writing the information listed in 3.4.1.1.1-6 to a shared memory block over the VME backplane bus to its counterpart ICP.
requirement_text_raw: Each interrupt shall (3.4.1.2.7) be preceded by the FCP writing the information listed in 3.4.1.1.1-6 to a shared memory block over the VME backplane bus to its counterpart ICP.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP to write the listed information to a shared memory block over the VME backplane bus before each interrupt, so that the ICP has the data it needs.
technical_task: Before every interrupt, write the information listed in 3.4.1.1.1-6 from the FCP to a shared memory block on the VME backplane bus for its counterpart ICP.
acceptance_criteria: Given an interrupt is about to be sent, when the FCP prepares it, then the information listed in 3.4.1.1.1-6 is written to the shared memory block.
Given the information is written, when the counterpart ICP reads the shared memory block, then it is available over the VME backplane bus.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The listed items are not given.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to create views that prohibit patients from accessing certain information according to organizational policy scope of practice and jurisdictional law.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide the ability to create views that prohibit patients from accessing certain information according to organizational policy  scope of practice  and jurisdictional law.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want to create views that stop patients from seeing certain information, so that disclosure follows policy and law.
technical_task: Support creating views that prohibit patients from accessing certain information according to organizational policy, scope of practice and jurisdictional law.
acceptance_criteria: Given a view that prohibits certain information, when a patient opens it, then the information is not shown.
Given the policy that applies, when a view is created, then it reflects the organizational policy, scope of practice and jurisdictional law.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The prohibited information is not listed.

requirement_text: Delivery boy shall be able to receive payment if the order is done with cash.
user_story: As a delivery boy, I want to receive payment when the order is paid in cash, so that I can collect what is owed.
technical_task: Let the delivery boy receive and record payment for cash orders.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order paid with cash, when the delivery boy delivers it, then the delivery boy can receive the payment.
Given an order paid by another method, when it is delivered, then no cash payment is requested.

requirement_text: The system shall deliver rapid responses to user requests under 24/7 operation for both internal and enforcement authority use (acceptable response time < 1 minute).
user_story: As an enforcement officer, I want rapid responses to my requests around the clock, with an acceptable response time of less than 1 minute, so that I can work without waiting.
technical_task: Operate 24/7 for internal and enforcement authority use and keep response time below 1 minute.
acceptance_criteria: Given any time of day, when a user makes a request, then the system responds.
Given a normal request, when the response time is measured, then it is less than 1 minute.
rationale: Role assumed: enforcement officer. "Rapid" is made concrete by the stated limit.

requirement_text: The SEP shall measure real-time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM).
requirement_text_raw: The SEP shall (3.3.10.13) measure real-time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the SEP to measure real time from this event with an accuracy of at most 50 Parts Per Million (PPM), so that timing is precise.
technical_task: Measure real time from the event in the SEP with an error of no more than 50 PPM.
acceptance_criteria: Given the event has occurred, when the SEP measures real time from it, then the accuracy is at most 50 PPM.
Given a measured time, when its error is evaluated, then it does not exceed 50 PPM.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. "This event" is not identified in the sentence.

requirement_text: A display shall not require a user to log in.
user_story: As a viewer, I want a display to work without my logging in, so that I can see it right away.
technical_task: Let displays show their content without requiring a login.
acceptance_criteria: Given a display, when a user opens it without logging in, then it is shown.
Given a display, when it is opened, then no login prompt is presented.

requirement_text: User shall be able to see a list of sessions associated with sponsor attendees, to engage with sponsors.
user_story: As an attendee, I want to see a list of sessions associated with sponsor attendees, so that I can engage with the sponsors.
technical_task: Show the sessions linked to sponsor attendees.
acceptance_criteria: Given sponsor attendees with sessions, when a user opens the list, then the sessions associated with sponsor attendees are shown.
Given a session with no sponsor attendee, when a user opens the list, then it is not shown.

requirement_text: The platform shall experience minimal to no buffering during video playback.
rationale: "Minimal to no buffering" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: Under which network conditions should this hold?

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to change their information at any time.
user_story: As a user, I want to change my information at any time, so that it stays correct.
technical_task: Allow users to edit their stored information whenever they like.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in user, when the user edits their information at any time, then the change is saved.
Given a saved change, when the user views their information, then the new values are shown.

requirement_text: The BE shall be able to make time stamp adjustments as required by the observational mode and correlator output parameters.
user_story: As an observatory engineer, I want the BE to adjust time stamps as the observational mode and correlator output parameters require, so that data is correctly timed.
technical_task: Let the BE make time stamp adjustments driven by the observational mode and the correlator output parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Given an observational mode that requires a time stamp adjustment, when it is active, then the BE makes the adjustment.
Given correlator output parameters that require a time stamp adjustment, when they are set, then the BE makes the adjustment.

requirement_text: Fit Criterion: Dr Susan Poslusny and Karen Sysol are the only people who shall have access to the final class section scheduling for the system that interfaces with CampusConnect.
requirement_text_raw: Fit Criterion: Dr Susan Poslusny and Karen Sysol are the only people who shall have access to the final class section scheduling for the system that interfaces with CampusConnect.'
user_story: As a registrar, I want only Dr Susan Poslusny and Karen Sysol to have access to the final class section scheduling, so that the schedule stays controlled.
technical_task: Limit access to the final class section scheduling for the system that interfaces with CampusConnect to Dr Susan Poslusny and Karen Sysol.
acceptance_criteria: Given Dr Susan Poslusny or Karen Sysol, when the person opens the final class section scheduling, then access is granted.
Given any other user, when the user opens the final class section scheduling, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: registrar. The two named people come from the requirement.

requirement_text: Submittal of a change request project memo shall include an unambiguous clear technical description of the requested change including any details required for understanding reason, purpose and impact of the requested change as well as a risk assessment with regards of component timing, cost, quality, safety, weight, function and performance.
user_story: As a technical reviewer, I want a change request project memo to include an unambiguous technical description and a risk assessment, so that I can judge the change.
technical_task: Require every change request project memo to contain a clear technical description with the reason, purpose and impact of the change, and a risk assessment covering component timing, cost, quality, safety, weight, function and performance.
acceptance_criteria: Given a change request project memo, when it is submitted, then it contains an unambiguous clear technical description of the change including its reason, purpose and impact.
Given a change request project memo, when it is submitted, then it contains a risk assessment covering component timing, cost, quality, safety, weight, function and performance.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to add musical notes and rests to a score using the mouse.
user_story: As a composer, I want to add musical notes and rests to a score using the mouse, so that I can write music.
technical_task: Support placing musical notes and rests on a score with mouse input.
acceptance_criteria: Given a score, when the user clicks to place a note with the mouse, then the note is added to the score.
Given a score, when the user clicks to place a rest with the mouse, then the rest is added to the score.

requirement_text: The in this document used definition of contact open / closed relates to the logical state and not to the electrical status of the input signal.
rationale: The sentence defines how "open" and "closed" are used in a document and states no behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a definition of terms?
Which signal behaviour must the system follow?

requirement_text: Clients shall be able to change their password.
user_story: As a client, I want to change my password, so that I can keep my account secure.
technical_task: Offer a password change function for clients.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in client, when the client enters a new password and confirms, then the password is changed.
Given the password has changed, when the client logs in again, then the new password is required.

requirement_text: The PayPal network must be available 24 hours a day to ensure continuous service availability.
user_story: As a customer, I want the PayPal network to be available 24 hours a day, so that I can pay at any time.
technical_task: Ensure the PayPal network is available for 24 hours every day.
acceptance_criteria: Given any hour of the day, when a customer pays through PayPal, then the network is available.
Given a full day, when availability is reviewed, then the network was available for 24 hours.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. No downtime allowance is stated.

requirement_text: The product shall have the ability to send meeting reminders to employees.
user_story: As an employee, I want to receive meeting reminders, so that I don't miss meetings.
technical_task: Send meeting reminders to employees.
acceptance_criteria: Given a scheduled meeting, when the reminder time comes, then a reminder is sent to the employee.
Given an employee who is not invited to the meeting, when the reminder time comes, then no reminder is sent.
rationale: Role assumed: employee. The reminder timing is not stated.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to implement a Chain of Trust agreement.
rationale: "Chain of Trust agreement" is named without describing what the solution must do.
clarification_questions: What does a Chain of Trust agreement have to contain?
Which parties and data does it cover?

requirement_text: The system shall provide security by encrypting user passwords stored in the database and protecting against online threats such as SQL injection attacks.
user_story: As a user, I want my stored passwords encrypted and the system protected against online threats such as SQL injection, so that my account is safe.
technical_task: Encrypt passwords stored in the database and add protection against online threats such as SQL injection attacks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user password, when it is stored in the database, then it is encrypted.
Given an SQL injection attempt, when it reaches the system, then it is blocked.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Other online threats are not listed.

requirement_text: If the requested appointment time does not conflict with any existing appointment for the LHCP the request is saved.
requirement_text_raw: If the requested appointment time does not conflict with any existing appointment for the LHCP  the request is saved.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want an appointment request saved only if it does not conflict with an existing appointment, so that my schedule has no overlaps.
technical_task: Save the appointment request when its time does not conflict with an existing appointment for the LHCP.
acceptance_criteria: Given a requested time that does not conflict with any existing appointment, when the request is submitted, then it is saved.
Given a requested time that conflicts with an existing appointment, when the request is submitted, then it is not saved.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The second criterion follows from "if it does not conflict".

requirement_text: When satisfied with your selections click 'Generate Report'.
requirement_text_raw: When satisfied with your selections  click 'Generate Report'.
rationale: The sentence is guidance for a user and describes no system behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an instruction to the user?
What must the system do when Generate Report is clicked?

requirement_text: User shall be able to access the application on all major web browsers without any slowdown, even during peak hours.
rationale: "All major web browsers", "any slowdown" and "peak hours" are not defined.

requirement_text: The system shall search for train schedules based on the provided origin and destination.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to search train schedules by origin and destination, so that I can plan my journey.
technical_task: Implement a train schedule search that takes an origin and a destination.
acceptance_criteria: Given an origin and a destination, when the traveler searches, then matching train schedules are listed.
Given an origin and destination with no train connection, when the traveler searches, then no schedules are listed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to respond to a limited number of profiles per day as a general job seeker.
clarification_questions: How many profiles per day count as "a limited number"?
What happens when the limit is reached?

requirement_text: The player clicks on the pushbutton "OK". The player statistics are recorded in the statistic file of the software, according to the requirement of the chapter 3.2.3.2.
user_story: As a player, I want my statistics recorded when I click "OK", so that my results are saved.
technical_task: Record the player statistics in the software's statistic file when the player clicks the "OK" pushbutton, per the requirement of chapter 3.2.3.2.
acceptance_criteria: Given the player clicks the pushbutton "OK", when the click is handled, then the player statistics are recorded.
Given the statistics are recorded, when the statistic file is opened, then it contains the player statistics.
rationale: Role stated: player. The chapter reference is kept as written.

requirement_text: A patient can click "View Full Calendar" link to view his or her appointments in the current month together with his or her office visit dates prescription dates and lab procedure dates in the current month displayed on a calendar for the current month .
requirement_text_raw: A patient can click "View Full Calendar" link to view his or her appointments in the current month together with his or her office visit dates  prescription dates  and lab procedure dates in the current month displayed on a calendar for the current month .
user_story: As a patient, I want to click "View Full Calendar" to see my appointments, office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates for the current month on a calendar, so that I have my month in one view.
technical_task: Add a "View Full Calendar" link that shows the current month's appointments and office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates on a calendar.
acceptance_criteria: Given the patient page, when the patient clicks "View Full Calendar", then a calendar for the current month is displayed.
Given the calendar for the current month, when it is displayed, then it shows the patient's appointments and office visit, prescription and lab procedure dates.

requirement_text: A customer shall be able to drag a tip denomination out of a bankcard payment or a cash payment.
requirement_text_raw: A customer shall be able to drag a tip denomination out of a bankcard payment  or a cash payment.
user_story: As a customer, I want to drag a tip denomination out of a bankcard payment or a cash payment, so that I can change my tip.
technical_task: Allow a tip denomination to be dragged out of either a bankcard payment or a cash payment.
acceptance_criteria: Given a bankcard payment with a tip denomination, when the customer drags the denomination out, then it is removed from the payment.
Given a cash payment with a tip denomination, when the customer drags the denomination out, then it is removed from the payment.
